pairing.mustCarry: pattern equal to the canonicalDecimal library literal
pairing.truth: DECIMAL_STRING scanner runs at the three casefile semantic gates and takes precedence over any pattern

patterns_registry.membership: J1: a schema pattern value must byte-equal exactly one library literal (UTF-8 bytes)
patterns_registry.loader_note: v0.12 K1: the library is an independent non-schema data resource; no validator compiles it and no keyword registration is used anywhere; the two frozen extension keywords remain the only extension keywords.

execution.table: per-entry execution_mode and matcher_id live in the packet-level validator-init.json under pattern_execution (kept out of the library so entries match the frozen I2 shape exactly: pattern / match_mode / domain / max_len)
execution.matcher_layer: shared matchers are the truth (matcher_id per entry in the table)
execution.hosted_pattern: for execution_mode=hosted_and entries, the hosted engine result participates with AND semantics; for matcher_only entries the hosted pattern is metadata and is not executed as a gate
execution.convergence: overall verdict = matcher AND hosted(where applicable); regressions covered by schema corpus including trailing-LF pathologies

patterns_registry.length_accounting: domain=ascii runs BEFORE max_len; on the ASCII path UTF-16 code units equal Unicode scalar values, so the two counts are equivalent after the gate; both sides nevertheless count Unicode scalar values explicitly (defense-in-depth); R6/R7 assert the gate order via exact stable codes

per_entry_audit.requirement: I2: every entry needs a length cap + ReDoS audit + dual-side corpus verdict samples

canonicalDecimal.redos: linear; alternation branches prefix-distinct; no nested quantifiers
canonicalDecimal.corpus: evidence/pattern_samples.py and .mjs (dual-side samples) + evidence/decimal_string_probe.py and .mjs (38 cases: H2 truth table + I1 additions + J3 additions) + schema corpus end-to-end (evi-05, cpl-07)

sha256Hex.corpus: evidence/pattern_samples.py and .mjs + schema corpus end-to-end (gvr-05, gvr-01)

jsonPointer.redos: linear; tilde excluded from the main class so the ~0/~1 branches are prefix-distinct; outer loop consumes at least one slash per iteration
jsonPointer.corpus: evidence/pattern_samples.py and .mjs; semantics note: control characters are allowed by the RFC 6901 token alphabet (the class only excludes slash and tilde) — call sites that need stricter identifiers must bound inputs additionally

isoTimestamp.corpus: evidence/pattern_samples.py and .mjs + schema corpus end-to-end (gvr-06); lexical-only (calendar fields are not validated)

lint_checks.rule: schemas must not contain the keyword 'format' (FORMAT_FORBIDDEN)
schemas must not contain 'unevaluatedProperties' (draft-07 does not define it)
every 'pattern' value byte-equals exactly one library literal; otherwise PATTERN_NOT_IN_LIBRARY
library literals are pairwise distinct; duplicates are PATTERN_LIBRARY_AMBIGUOUS
'x-canonical' appears only on array nodes; value in set|seq
'x-decimal-string' appears only on string nodes with value true and must pair with the canonicalDecimal literal
$ref is either absolute form 'bundle://<manifest-path>[#pointer]' or same-file fragment form '#<pointer>'
no remote or relative refs (REF_REMOTE_FORBIDDEN / REF_FORM_INVALID); bundle-escape is REF_ESCAPE
every bundle file carries $schema (draft-07) and $id = bundle://<manifest path>
the 'patterns' keyword appears only in meta/pattern-library.json (data resource; never compiled by any validator)
object schemas declare type:'object' alongside 'properties' (ajv strictTypes)
arrays intended for runtime use must carry an x-canonical annotation somewhere so runtime UNANNOTATED_ARRAY rejections are intentional
